evidence: Extracted and inspected the original supplied video at00:05. It looks past the hotel’s distinctive gold/orange vertical façade toward Fort Canning’s sloped lawn and Singapore skyline; Clarke Quay roofs are below.

CDL Hospitality Trusts2019annual report, printed page65 (PDFpage67), names Novotel Singapore Clarke Quay and shows a photograph of the same orange/gold tower above the Clarke Quay roofs. It states that rooms offer Fort Canning Park views.

The owner report states the hotel would cease operations in early April2020 for redevelopment. Thus the teammate’s approximate2021closure should not be copied. New Otani was an earlier name of this property, whereas the identified hotel in the supplied video is Novotel Singapore Clarke Quay.
